description: Market-cap showdown of major crypto exchange tokens & the Coinbase IPO — a real-world chart race showing one token's meteoric rise, another's total wipeout (FTX), and how centralized-exchange power concentrated after 2017. Uses verified market-cap peaks, the 2021 crypto boom, and the FTX November 2022 collapse as anchor events.
youtube_description:
Chart race: exchange tokens and Coinbase stock, 2007–2026. Watch BNB rise from zero to tens of billions, see FTT explode then implode to near zero after FTX's November 2022 collapse, and follow Coinbase's IPO spike in 2021. This dataset is built on real market-cap events: Binance launch (2017), token burning and growth during the 2020–21 crypto bull run, Coinbase's April 2021 public listing, and the FTX bankruptcy that wiped billions from FTT and rearranged centralized-exchange power.

Why this matters: centralized-exchange tokens are a mirror of the industry's concentration — one token can consolidate enormous value, while regulatory shocks and fraud can erase it overnight. Perfect for a high-contrast chart-race video: dramatic rises, sudden collapses, and long recoveries.

If you use this for a video: credit real-world events (Binance launch, Coinbase IPO, FTX bankruptcy Nov 2022) in captions. Want a CSV or alternate timeframe? Comment below and I’ll tailor it.
